Manchester Bakery Opens Three Sites, Creating 45 Jobs

MANCHESTER, UK — 12 March 2026 — Pollen & Crumb will open three new bakeries across Greater Manchester by June, creating 45 full-time jobs and doubling the company's production capacity.

The independent chain, which runs two sites in Chorlton and Didsbury, has secured £1.2m from the Greater Manchester Combined Authority growth fund and NatWest. The new kitchens in Salford, Stockport and Altrincham will each supply nearby cafés and delis.

"We have turned down wholesale orders every week for two years because we could not bake enough," said Amara Okafor, founder and managing director of Pollen & Crumb. "These three kitchens change that. Every one of those 45 jobs is a permanent contract on the real living wage."

Revenue grew 34% in 2025 to £2.8m, driven mainly by wholesale demand. The company expects the new sites to take annual revenue past £4m by the end of 2027.

All three kitchens will run the same shift pattern as the Chorlton site, with baking from 4am and wholesale deliveries completed by 9am. Okafor said the company had deliberately kept the new sites within a 12-mile radius so that a single fleet of four vans could serve all of them, holding logistics costs flat while volume triples.

The Salford kitchen is the largest of the three at 4,000 square feet and will also take over celebration cake production from Didsbury, freeing that site to extend its retail hours to seven days a week from July.

"Independent food producers scaling up in the North West is exactly what the growth fund exists for," said Tom Reilly, head of business lending at NatWest Manchester. "Pollen & Crumb had the demand and the discipline. They needed the ovens."

Recruitment for the 45 roles opens on 20 March, with the Salford site trading from 4 May.

About Pollen & Crumb
Pollen & Crumb is an independent bakery founded in Manchester in 2020 by Amara Okafor. It bakes sourdough, pastries and celebration cakes for two retail sites and around 30 wholesale customers across Greater Manchester, and employs 38 people.
